verdict.rationale: The documented `--server` mode exposes an HTTP server with "API" options (docs-9). It serves a local endpoint at localhost:8080 that answers incoming connections (docs-5, docs-10), so the product can be driven programmatically. However, the pack never documents the API's endpoints, request/response formats, or compatibility (e.g., OpenAI-style), and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path (probe-3). Missing for 10: documented API endpoint reference, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API usage examples, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
